Subject: Temporary relocation of the third-floor copy room
Date: March 4

Dear colleagues,

We apologize for the inconvenience and appreciate your patience.

Best regards,
Renata Okafor

Starting February 1, the City of Elmsworth will simplify its curbside recycling program in response to resident feedback and rising processing costs. Please review the following changes, which apply to all single-family homes and buildings with fewer than eight units.
